name: docker-kb-checks
description: Behaviors backing docker KB claims, verified with `docker compose config` (Docker Compose 5.3.1, no daemon required) and PyPI resolution

cases.description: Merged stack (postgres-service + airflow-local-compose + python-uv-dockerfile + dbt-runner-container excerpts) is a valid Compose model
cases.input: docker compose -p dw -f postgres.yaml -f airflow.yaml -f ingest.yaml -f dbt.yaml config --quiet

cases.description: Services with a profile are excluded unless the profile is activated
cases.input: docker compose config --services (without / with --profile tools --profile jobs)
cases.expected: 6 services without profiles; adds dbt and ingest with profiles

cases.description: Short depends_on is normalized to condition service_started
${VAR:?msg} aborts interpolation when the variable is unset
cases.expected: required variable DW_PASSWORD is missing a value: set DW_PASSWORD (exit 1)

cases.description: ${VAR-default} keeps an empty value; ${VAR:-default} replaces it
Shell environment overrides the .env file for interpolation
cases.expected: from_shell (and from_dotenv when the shell var is absent)

cases.description: Named volumes, networks and secrets are prefixed with the project name
cases.input: name: dw with volumes pgdata, airflow-db and secret pg_password

cases.description: Top-level version key only triggers a warning
cases.expected: warning: the attribute `version` is obsolete, it will be ignored

cases.description: Pinned dbt versions used in dbt-runner-container / airflow Dockerfiles resolve for Python 3.12 linux wheels
